minecraft:written_book_content.title: A Letter, Unsent
minecraft:written_book_content.author: E. Vance
pages:
I don't know how to file what just happened, so I'm not going to. I'm writing it to you instead.

You didn't seal him. You remembered him. And the readings didn't spike — they opened. Like a door that had been painted shut for forty years.
He's whole. He's somewhere. He is, for the first time since I was a child, HIM. I should be terrified. UMBRA is terrified. They're already drafting the memos.
Because here's what they won't say out loud: the thing that erased him was never just here, in this site. The Hollow doesn't live in the Frame. The Frame was a bandage.

And you just took the bandage off.

Thorne is free, and he remembers everything — including what's on the other side of forgetting. He knows where it lives now. And I think he's going to go looking for it.

UMBRA wants to hire you to clean this up. I want to hire you to help me follow him.

They are not the same job. Choose carefully. I'll be in touch.

— Eleanor
